name: A Conscious Decision
source:
You are a wisp of consciousness in Jane's mind.  Uncover the details of her past, make choices in the present and play until you attain a happy future.
[From [url=https://kaelynmauve.itch.io/consciousdecision] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是简心中的一缕意识。揭开她过去的细节，做出现在的选择，玩下去，直到获得幸福的未来。
[来自[url=https://kaelynmauve.itch.io/consciousdecision] itch.io[/url]]
